segments.say: Paris, 1858. Paul Morphy plays this game at the opera house, and it's still taught to beginners today.
segments.caption: Morphy, Paris 1858

segments.say: Morphy develops fast and sacrifices pieces to open lines to the black king.
segments.caption: Every piece attacking

segments.say: Rook takes d7. Rook takes back. Another rook joins the attack.
segments.caption: Rook sacrifice

segments.say: Bishop takes d7, check. Knight takes back. And now the queen sacrifice: queen b8, check!
segments.caption: Queen b8!!

segments.say: The knight has to take. Rook d8. Checkmate.
segments.caption: Rook d8 mate

segments.say: Fast development and open lines win games. Would you play like Morphy?
segments.caption: Could YOU play like this?

yt_title: The most famous chess game ever ♟️ Morphy's Opera Game #chess
desc:
Paul Morphy vs the Duke of Brunswick and Count Isouard - played at the Paris Opera in 1858.

Morphy develops fast, sacrifices a rook and then his QUEEN, and finishes with 17.Rd8#.

Would you play like Morphy? 👇
